# chart_stat_gop {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
chart_stat_gop(p_p0, chart_choice)
chart_stat_gop(p_p0, G1G, ::G_Chart)
```
Compute the chart statistic for generalized ordinal patterns (GOPs) from the vector of deviations `p_p0 = p - p0`, where `p` holds the estimated GOP frequencies and `p0` the in-control GOP distribution (see [`fill_p0!`](fill_p0!.qmd)).
 
  * `p_p0`: vector of length 13 with the deviations of the estimated GOP frequencies from the in-control distribution.
  * `chart_choice`: [`D_Chart`](D_Chart.qmd)`()` or `Persistence()`.
  * `G1G`: weighting matrix `G'G` used by the G-chart method.
Returns the value of the chart statistic.
 


:::
